This must be the chair you sit in to ope: Please, don't be alarmed. We intend no harm. We are a peaceful race. We are cautious, however. Others don't share our way of life. Welcome to Kerona.
這應該是操作電腦時坐的椅子。: 「別緊張，我們沒有惡意。我們是愛好和平的種族，只是比較謹慎——不是每個種族都跟我們一樣。歡迎來到柯羅娜星。」

This must be the chair you sit in to ope: You are standing in the power generation facility of our underground settlement. All power here is produced by steam. That is unimportant to you, however. We have promised you transportation.
這應該是操作電腦時坐的椅子。: 「你現在站的地方，是我們地下聚落的發電設施。這裡所有的電力都靠蒸汽產生，不過這對你來說不重要。我們答應過要給你交通工具。」

This must be the chair you sit in to ope: It is a Skimmer. It hovers approximately 1/2 meter above the traveling surface. This is very important because of Grell.

This must be the chair you sit in to ope: Grell and his like dwell in caves below the sand. If you stand on the surface too long, you chance becoming a rare moist meal for him.
這應該是操作電腦時坐的椅子。: 「格瑞爾跟他的同類住在沙地底下的洞穴裡。你要是在地表站太久，很可能就會變成他難得一見的『多汁大餐』。」

This must be the chair you sit in to ope: The skimmer is programmed to take you to a settlement on the other side of Kerona called Ulence Flats. You can make further travel arrangements there.

This must be the chair you sit in to ope: That's real cute. Now can we discuss buying a spaceship? I'm only here to serve you. Talk to me.
